newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips guard gains as bonds surge.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips guard gains as bonds surge.

text.p: The Dow industrials were buoyant on Tuesday, basking in a weaker-than-expected National Association of Purchasing Managers report which pointed to tame inflation and steady interest rates.

U.S. blue chip stocks and bonds were heartened by the benign manufacturing data and fairly sure U.S. interest rates would not change, as markets awaited the start of a Federal Reserve policy maker meeting, analysts said.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 52 points to 7726 and the long bond was up 20/32 at a 6.74 percent yield.
But tech stocks were soft, with Nasdaq down 5.33 at 1437.
